title: 你的智能体通过了任务，但它能再次做到吗？
summary: IBM Research 在 Hugging Face 博客发布文章，介绍其 ALTK Evolve 框架中关于智能体一致性的研究。文章指出，当前对 AI 智能体的评估通常只关注单次任务成功率，却忽略了关键问题：同一个智能体在重复执行相同或相似任务时，能否稳定地再次成功。这种不一致性在真实部署中会带来严重风险，例如自动化流程时好时坏、用户信任下降、调试困难等。为此，作者提出将一致性作为智能体评估的一等公民，并展示了 ALTK Evolve 如何通过系统化方法衡量和改进智能体行为的一致性。文章可能涵盖一致性度量指标、重复运行实验设计、失败模式分析，以及如何利用进化式优化提升智能体稳定性。核心观点是：一个真正可靠的智能体不仅要能完成任务，更要在多次尝试中可预测地复现成功。该工作对智能体评测、可靠性工程和生产部署具有重要参考价值。
summary_en: IBM Research publishes a blog post on Hugging Face introducing work from its ALTK Evolve framework on agent consistency. The article argues that current evaluations of AI agents typically focus only on single-run task success rates, overlooking a critical question: can the same agent reliably succeed again when repeating the same or similar tasks? Such inconsistency poses serious risks in real-world deployment, including flaky automation, eroded user trust, and difficult debugging. To address this, the authors propose treating consistency as a first-class citizen in agent evaluation and demonstrate how ALTK Evolve systematically measures and improves the consistency of agent behavior. The post likely covers consistency metrics, repeated-run experiment design, failure mode analysis, and how evolutionary optimization can enhance agent stability. The core message is that a truly reliable agent must not only complete tasks but also predictably reproduce success across multiple attempts. This work offers valuable insights for agent benchmarking, reliability engineering, and production deployment.
